entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about my fitness band. It's... it's just not working. I'm a little confused about what to do.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly look into it for you. Could I start with your full name and order number, please?
Sure, it's a... Sarah Jenkins. The order number is... VF886120.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A fault, I think? I've been trying to get it set up and it just won't sync with my phone. I feel like it's broken or something. The app just doesn't see it.
I see. So the main problem is that the band is not working because it won't sync with your device. That sounds very frustrating.
It is! I just think the unit I received must be defective. I don't know what else it could be. I'm not very good with this stuff... can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. Let me just pull up our policies here to see what the best next step is. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've just reviewed your account and our return information. I see you received the item 31 days ago.
Yes... is that a problem? With the holidays and everything I just didn't get to it sooner.

Not a problem at all. Our company policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process this as a return for a full refund.
Oh! Really? You can just take it back? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried it was too late.

I'm happy to help. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending an email to you now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the band in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making this easy, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
